errors.text_span: 一条带有空心三角形标记的虚线
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the line style for label '5' as a dashed line ('虚线'). According to the legend and the plot, the line for label '5' is a dash-dot line ('-.-').

The description states the starting Y-value for label '5' (triangle marker) is approximately 0.449. However, the chart shows this line starts at approximately 0.450. The value 0.449 corresponds to the starting point of the line for label '7' (square marker).

The description states that the line for label '6' (diamond marker) starts at Y-value of approximately 0.451. The chart shows this line starts at approximately 0.450. The value 0.451 is closer to the starting point of the line for label '5' (triangle marker).

The description states that the line for label '7' (square marker) ends at a Y-value of approximately 0.466. The chart shows this point is higher, at approximately 0.467. The value 0.466 corresponds to the Y-value of the line for label '6' (diamond marker) at X=6.
